answer: Require every agent identity to post a time-locked stake that is slashed when the same operator is caught running duplicates, and to renew it with a fresh, non-transferable proof of useful work each epoch. Creating one honest identity is cheap, but forging a thousand costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand distinct work proofs, so a karst of cheap fake accounts collapses under its own cost while a crystal-clear audit trail shows which identities actually did the work, and the shale-thin margin of a Sybil farm disappears.
